ns5:Paragraph.Text: FOR ON-GOING TIMATIC OPERATIONAL SUPPORT PLEASE USE THE ESTABLISHED SUPPORT CHANNELS LISTED BELOW:
WHEN PROMPTED FOR A CUSTOMER ID, PRESS ZERO AND THEN ENTER CUSTOMER ID NUMBER 475

THIS APPLICATION SHOULD BE CONSULTED FOR AIRLINE PASSENGERS TRAVELING ONLY AS TOURISTS, ON BUSINESS OR ON DUTY. IF A COUNTRY SECTION HAS NO SPECIFIC OR EXPLICIT REFERENCE TO EITHER, IT GENERALLY IMPLIES THAT REQUIREMENTS (OR THE EXEMPTION THEREOF) ARE THE SAME FOR ALL CATEGORIES. THE TERM "TOURISTS" IMPLIES THOSE TRAVELING FOR LEISURE OR FOR SOCIAL REASONS, SUCH AS VISITING FAMILY AND FRIENDS. THE TERM "BUSINESS" IMPLIES THOSE COMING TO ATTEND MEETINGS, CONFERENCES, EXHIBITIONS AND SIMILAR ACTIVITIES, AS LONG AS THERE IS NO SALARY OR INCOME EARNED FROM A SOURCE WITHIN THE COUNTRY OR TERRITORY BEING VISITED. THE TERM "DUTY" APPLIES TO GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS, MERCHANT SEAMEN, AIRLINE CREW OR MILITARY. THIS APPLICATION IS NOT INTENDED FOR THOSE SEEKING INFORMATION ON HOW TO IMMIGRATE, PERSONS WISHING TO ADOPT CHILDREN, WISHING TO STUDY OR TAKE UP PAID EMPLOYMENT ABROAD, OR INDIVIDUALS CROSSING BORDERS OVERLAND. THOSE PASSENGERS SHOULD BE REFERRED TO THE CONSULATE OF THE COUNTRY CONCERNED.
VISITORS ARE REQUIRED TO HOLD PROOF OF SUFFICIENT FUNDS TO COVER THEIR STAY AND DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR THEIR NEXT DESTINATION.
